articles.title: U.S. widens Iran crackdown to encompass crypto, gold, shipping and technology
articles.snippet: Treasury says Ivan Obukhov processed over $100 million in crypto for IRGC-QF oil sales since 2023.

articles.title: Treasury’s bond buyback plan fights the market and heightens the danger, billionaire Druckenmiller says
articles.snippet: The billionaire investor argues the intervention removes a vital check on government borrowing and fiscal accountability while markets remain the better judge of prices.

articles.title: Crypto rally spills into dog and cat memecoins as smaller tokens double in a week
articles.snippet: Robinhood Chain-based Cash Cat jumped more than 50% in a day, while several smaller animal-themed tokens have gained between 50% and 130% over the past week.

articles.title: Arcus launches tokenized perp positions on Robinhood Chain
articles.snippet: Arcus introduced transferable ERC-20 tokens for perpetual positions and lets tokenized stocks back leveraged trades without requiring users to sell their holdings.

articles.title: Korean bank taps Ripple for payments, Pakistan opens crypto licensing: Asia Express
articles.snippet: Asia’s biggest crypto hubs are locked in a tax-cut arms race, while Ripple will help Korea’s Jeonbuk Bank move money across borders.
